defects_found_by_commissioning: verify_result checked residue against the CLASSIFICATION rather than the set actually cleared, so it failed its own --preserve-guests option by demanding a table it had been told to keep be empty. Fixed by verifying against intent rather than taxonomy.
backups from a commissioning run landed in the production backup store, which is how a rehearsal artefact ends up looking like a production event. Fixed by adding --backup-dir.
defect_found_by_the_tool_on_its_author: the first dry run aborted on notification_logs, a table the classification had missed. There is no default and no catch-all, which is exactly the omission reset_transactional_data.py makes silently for four tables.
